name: 多菇丁
evolution: 菇菇丁 → 多菇丁 Lv.36 → 九幽菇 Lv.48
description: 又有了新的发现，多菇丁埋地时，是在通过菌丝体往地下传播信号，向其他菇精灵发出指令，它们信号的语言结构和古文字非常相似，也许它们的历史远比洛克以为的要早得多。
descriptionEn: A new discovery: when Duoguding buries into the ground, it is transmitting signals underground through mycelium, issuing commands to other mushroom spirits. The language structure of their signals is very similar to ancient script; perhaps their history is far older than what Roco imagines.
